segments.text: V. 40. Here is the Sum of the three foregoing Verſes. This is the will of him that ſent me—This is the whole of what I have ſaid: This is the eternal, unchangeable Will of COD. Every one who truly believeth, ſhall have everlaſting Life. Every one that ſeeth and believeth—The Jews ſaw, and yet believed not. And I will raiſe him up—As this is the Will of Him that ſent me, I will perform it effectually.
